mentions.name: Scalemate
mentions.description: This AI co-founder app helps users validate their startup idea, build a business model, and reach the right investors in one focused flow; users describe what they are working on and the AI agent guides the next steps.
mentions.problem: Founders commonly make typical mistakes while validating ideas, building business models, and pitching investors.
mentions.audience: Founders building startups who want help validating ideas and reaching investors
mentions.source_excerpt:
Scalemate — your AI co-founder
Validate your idea, build a business model, and reach the right investors — all in one focused flow. Just describe what you're working on, and Scalemate will guide the next steps.
